MINI MINUTES: JUDGE LINDA COLFAX Clerk: Jacque Willis-McGhee Reporter: T. WARD, #11918

C/C FOR PETITION REQUESTING THAT THE COURT UPHOLD THE ORDER ISSUED ON JUNE 17, 2010 CHANGING MINOR'S NAME; ATTY FOR MINOR VICKY TRAPALIS PRESENT; COURT HEARS THE ARGUMENT SUPPORTING REQUEST AND FINDS GOOD CAUSE TO GRANT REQUEST; COURT SIGNS ORDER PREPARE BY MS TRAPALIS.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Jun-17-2010 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: William R. Gargano, Clerk: Kevin Dougherty, CSR: Arlene Howell, #2542.

Petitioner Shanay Carter was present in pro per as Guardian ad Litem for the minor, Jadie Marice Carter.
Petitioner was placed under oath examined.
Proof of Publication in the file.

No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of the Minor to Da'Mariye Jadie Marice Lewis.

Decree Changing Name was submitted to and signed by the Court.
